ranking_basis: source and philological closure of the unresolved mechanic
deterministic implementation readiness under the existing fail-closed architecture
dependency depth on unresolved calendar/time-coordinate engines
ability to preserve ambiguity without selecting a historical winner
avoidance of already exhausted acquisition routes and duplicate research

ranked_queue.field: Later calendar-age years plus remainder-days Jiaoyun method
ranked_queue.reason: The Qianli worked method is explicit and the generic HISTORICAL-CHINESE-CALENDAR-ADAPTER-CONTRACT-R1 already has the required architecture. The remaining blocker is comparatively narrow: establish the exact Republican/Qianli calendar coordinate, invalid-date policy, remainder-day addition semantics and recurrence relation before registering a regime descriptor.

ranked_queue.field: Nanyangtang Fullbook ten-ke Zi/Hai split natal birth-hour candidate
ranked_queue.reason: Direct Nanyangtang and Guangyi Fullbook evidence is strong and the upper/lower timekeeping orientation is closed, but runtime time-standard binding and the Fullbook-line inclement current-time procedure remain unresolved. Reviewed Google/public-preview routes are exhausted and must not be repeated.

ranked_queue.field: Classical lunisolar first Jiaoyun calendarization with small/leap-month correction
ranked_queue.reason: Ming Datong evidence is extensive and several subrules are closed, but a general executable adapter still depends on qishuo geography, invalid-date/month-length arithmetic, multi-year leap behavior and general precision certification.

ranked_queue.field: Ten-year Dayun exchange recurrence from first handover
ranked_queue.reason: The ten-year recurrence concept is strong, but historical calendar realization must inherit the exact regime used for the first handover. It cannot close independently before at least one source-scoped first-handover adapter is certified.

selected_next.objective: Audit the Qianli/Republican Jiaoyun worked examples for exact calendar-coordinate, invalid-date, remainder-day-addition and recurrence semantics. Register no Republican/Qianli regime descriptor and expose no runtime candidate until those source semantics close.
